انشغلن (form VII)
# اِنْشَغَلْنَ (inšaḡalna) /in.ʃa.ɣal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
# اِنْشَغِلْنَ (inšaḡilna) /in.ʃa.ɣil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْشَغَلَ (inšaḡala)
